purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and schema-first anonymous geometry review.
assessment: Sorocaba’s official planning-secretariat GIS page offers informational maps and downloadable geospatial ZIP files. Municipal planning/government sources describe geoprocessing and cartographic layers for lots and buildings used to update the municipal property cadastre. This establishes municipal cadastral-map custody, not a land-title registry or a verified public parcel-vector endpoint. The municipal GIS page confirms downloadable ZIP geospatial data, but the accessible page does not expose layer names or feature schemas. Tax/property-account services require identifying information and were not accessed.
